presets.name: Random Euclidean
presets.code:
pulses = randint(1, steps)
pattern = euclidean(pulses, steps)

presets.name: Sparse Decay
presets.code: pattern = [p and random() > (loop_count * 0.03) for p in pattern]

presets.name: Gate Pulse
presets.desc: Gate breathes between staccato and legato

presets.name: Melodic Walk
presets.code:
octave = max(-2, min(2, octave + choice([-1, 0, 0, 0, 1])))
interval = max(-5, min(5, interval + choice([-1, 0, 0, 1])))

presets.name: Evolving Euclid
presets.code:
p = 3 + int(4 * abs(sin(loop_count * 0.4)))
pattern = euclidean(p, steps)
velocity = 80 + int(40 * sin(loop_count * 0.7))

presets.name: Chaos Burst
Breath
presets.desc: Velocity, gate and prob breathe together
presets.code:
phase = loop_count * 0.3
velocity = int(64 + 55 * sin(phase))
gate = 0.25 + 0.7 * abs(sin(phase * 0.7))
prob = max(0.2, 0.4 + 0.55 * abs(sin(phase * 0.5)))

presets.name: Pendulum
presets.desc: Interval pendulum, octave follows, vel inverse
presets.code:
interval = int(round(4 * sin(loop_count * 0.4)))
if loop_count % 8 == 0:
    octave = choice([-1, 0, 0, 1])
velocity = int(80 + 35 * cos(loop_count * 0.4))

presets.name: Tidal
presets.desc: Slow tide, everything rises and falls
presets.code:
tide = sin(loop_count * 0.1)
velocity = int(80 + 40 * tide)
gate = 0.4 + 0.5 * abs(tide)
octave = int(round(tide))
interval = int(round(3 * tide))

presets.name: Ratchet Fever
presets.desc: Ratchets escalate every 8 cycles then burst
presets.code:
r = 1 + (loop_count % 8) // 2
ratchet = r
if loop_count % 8 == 7:
    pattern = [random() > 0.3 for _ in range(steps)]
velocity = int(75 + 7 * r)
gate = max(0.1, 0.85 - r * 0.1)

presets.name: Harmonic Rise
presets.desc: Interval climbs scale, mirrors at peak
presets.code:
interval = (loop_count % 8) - 4
if loop_count % 8 == 7:
    pattern = mirror(pattern)
velocity = int(65 + 50 * abs(sin(loop_count * 0.55)))

presets.name: Drunk Melody
presets.desc: Drunk walk pattern, octave and interval walk
presets.code:
pattern = drunk_walk(steps, 0.25)
octave = max(-2, min(2, octave + choice([-1, 0, 0, 0, 1])))
interval = max(-5, min(5, interval + choice([-1, 0, 0, 1])))
velocity = randint(65, 105)

presets.name: Ghost Notes
presets.desc: Low prob and random velocity, ghost feel

presets.name: Euclid Morph
presets.desc: Oscillating pulses, vel and gate adapt
presets.code:
p = 2 + int(5 * abs(sin(loop_count * 0.3)))
pattern = euclidean(p, steps)
velocity = 80 + int(p * 5)
gate = 0.35 + p * 0.07
note_len = 1 if p > 5 else choice([1, 2, 2, 4])

presets.name: Cascade
presets.desc: Stutter and octave drops, then wobble

presets.name: Phase Drift
presets.desc: Slow rotation, interval and gate sinusoidal
presets.code:
pattern = rotate(pattern, loop_count % steps)
interval = int(3 * sin(loop_count * 0.25))
gate = 0.2 + 0.7 * abs(sin(loop_count * 0.15))

presets.name: Tension Arc
presets.desc: Octave, interval, vel and gate arc over 16 cycles
presets.code:
phase = (loop_count % 16) / 16.0
octave = int(round(-1 + 2 * abs(sin(phase * pi))))
interval = int(round(-3 + 6 * phase))
velocity = int(60 + 60 * abs(sin(phase * pi)))
gate = 0.3 + 0.6 * phase
